entities.name: Phosphoglycerate kinase
observations: The 392-residue query is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt protein B8GP44 and has 100% coverage.
The query contains the PGK domain Pfam PF00162.25 spanning residues 6–378.
Reviewed homologs consistently annotate EC 2.7.2.3, cytosolic localization, and monomeric subunit organization.

entities.name: 3-phosphoglycerate phosphorylation
observations: Phosphoglycerate kinase catalyzes (2R)-3-phosphoglycerate + ATP ⇌ 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate + ADP; UniProt/Rhea mapping is EC 2.7.2.3 and RHEA:14801.
The reaction is reversible and functions in glycolysis and gluconeogenesis.
